CustomObject.description: One record per individual issue or strength identified by a scorer for a given (article assessment, dimension). Replaces the semicolon-separated text in KB_Dimension_Result__c.Reasoning__c with structured rows so the Action Center and remediation prompts can act on (and reference) each finding individually. Both Issue and Strength records flow through this object — discriminated by Type__c.
CustomObject.label: KB Dimension Analysis
